title: EquiCVD Bench: calibration and subgroup fairness of U.S. cardiovascular risk tools on NHANES 1999-2018
description: Open benchmark of calibration and subgroup fairness of U.S. cardiovascular risk tools (PCE, PCE-revised, PREVENT, non-laboratory Framingham, explainable ML) on NHANES 1999-2018 with NCHS 2019 public-use linked mortality. Includes data download, cohort construction, survey-weighted IPCW evaluation with Rao-Wu bootstrap, and sensitivity analyses.
